verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an AI video and image generation platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents a batch or bulk feature that acts on many items at once. The API, the dedicated-throughput tier, Luma Skills ('run it forever') and multi-step Agents are building blocks or adjacent features (reuse, capacity, recurrence), not a documented bulk-operation capability. They therefore earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
